newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE products jump, but demand only for fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: NWE products jump, but demand only for fuel oil.

text.p: NWE oil products leaped on futures gains, but prices were more notional with end-user demand seen only for fuel oil, dealers said.
Gasoline was offered at $206 fob ARA, up $2 a tonne. Traders said one major was a possible bidder at $204.
Gas oil futures were $2.75 firmer, having earlier risen by over $5. Early September deliveries were offered at a high premium of Sept +$2, but the strength of the IPE left no buyers.
High sulphur fuel oil barges traded three times at $100, a gain of about $3 a tonne. Bunker demand was fair.
